title: Many longtime Etsy sellers say they are leaving after Etsy updated its terms to say Etsy and its third-party partners can use sellers' content for AI training (Reggie Ugwu/New York Times)
summary: Reggie Ugwu / New York Times: Many longtime Etsy sellers say they are leaving after Etsy updated its terms to say Etsy and its third-party partners can use sellers' content for AI training — Numerous longtime users of the online marketplace have left the platform because they do not want their work training artificial intelligence.
